candidates.name: IsWow64Process2
verified_facts: Returns or defines native and emulated processor architecture, address range, allocation granularity, processor count, or WOW64 machine information.
semantic_limits: Architecture values constrain interpretation but do not authenticate the executable, module bytes, task identity, or receipt lineage.

candidates.name: PE format machine types
verified_facts: Defines or locates Portable Executable machine, NT, file, optional, and section headers used for image-layout interpretation.
semantic_limits: PE headers can be malformed, stale, or unrelated to the loaded image; acceptance requires strict bounds checks plus exact file and loaded-module identity and digest correlation.
